speech:
Alright, Grizzly Rips, gather round. That's a B today, and you earned every letter of it.

We woke up this morning with a relegation match hanging over us, needing just a draw to stay in Division 3. We didn't tiptoe through it. We won it 3-0 against LOS REGIDOS, clean sheet and all. Then we climbed right up to 12 points and into the promotion matches for Division 2. We won the first one 5-2, then dropped the next 2, and that's where the series ended. So we finish the day where we started it, in Division 3, back at 0 points but with all 3 chances in our pocket. Last week was an F. This week we went from trying to survive to knocking on the door upstairs. That is real progress.

Now the honest part. We let in 23 goals in 7 matches. That's 3.29 a match, and 2 of our losses were by 4 or more, including an 8-2 hiding from kromium when it mattered most. Too many of those came from forcing passes. Below about 72% passing, the extra ones start costing us. If nothing's on, keep it, turn back and let the shape reset. A sideways pass that keeps the ball beats a forward one that gifts it away.

PhogsToffees, you were the engine today. 8 goals, 7 assists, an 8.29 against your usual 7.67, and a perfect 10.0 against AC Jarca, your 4th perfect match for us. You were hungry all day. But against Mohamedudeman their forward put up a 10.0 to your 6.5, and you went missing in that one. Your passing in the opener sat at 64%, so even on a good day, tidy it up.

buddskees, you came in for 5 matches and made them count. A 9.7 against AC Jarca, 3 assists against Warrior Minded, and 4 shots on target against FcCHI400s. That's a player who wants the ball. But against Mohamedudeman you had 0 on-ball actions and a 5.7. Zero. You've got to find the match even when it isn't finding you.

tuxedo_slide, you took your chances. 11 of 12 shots on target, a 9.3 against Warrior Minded, and you converted 67% against AC Jarca. Now, 8 of 22 passes in that same match is 36%, and 61% for the day is the forcing problem. Pick the simple ball.

BellyTb1, 15 of 16 shots on target is darn near witchcraft, and you won 50% of your tackles against a usual 30%. That's grit. But you dropped to 46% passing against FcCHI400s and missed 3 tackles against kromium.

Here's the thing, friends. A week ago we were scraping. Today we stood one step from Division 2. The ladder knocked us down a rung, sure, but y'all already know the way back up, because you just walked it. Keep the ball, trust each other, and let's go climb it again.
